name: vllm-rocm-w7900-main
description: vLLM runtime image for AMD Radeon W7900 / RDNA3 / gfx1100 assembled from vllm-rocm-w7900-main-wheel. Uses the same daily pytorch-rocm-w7900 base as the wheel builder, filters wheel constraints to ROCm/PyTorch ABI pins, then installs the prebuilt wheel and validates torch/vLLM import.
